Question: I have seen many times in my dreams that i was walking on road or some where far from my home bare footed (having no shoes like thing in my feet) i see my self very tensed in my dreams, i mean during that dream , can u please just send me any thing wat should i do? Answer ID: 1556 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1149/866=H) There is lack of taqwa and sincerity. If you spend some time in Jamat Tabligh abiding by its rules, this will remove the fault, in-sha-Allah. If you fear in dream recite اعوذ باللہ من الشیطان الرجیم lying on your left side and spit three times. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
